text: Sorry for writting so late, im the nan and ive got my granddaughter stopping with me this week, shes 5. She hasnt done a poo for three days now which isnt like her at all, normaly shes like clockwork. Shes been really grumpy about it, sitting on the toilet and getting cross when nothing happens and saying she doesnt want to go anymore. Ive been giving her plenty of water and some fruit and a bit of brown bread but no luck so far. Shes eating ok and playing ok otherwise its just the poo thing and the mood. I dont really know what you can give a child that age for it and I dont want to give her anything I shouldnt, her mum and dad are away so its just me. Im so tired ive been up and down with her all evening and I thought I better ask somone who knows before I go getting something from the chemist tomorow. Is there anything I can do tonight or just wait and see
